question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Forty winks
solution:
The correct answer is '**To take a short nap**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given idiom '**Forty winks**' refers to a short sleep or nap, typically taken during the day. 

 
 
• **Example**: Feeling tired after the long drive, John grabbed **forty winks** before the party.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning for the idiom '**Forty winks**' is '**To take a short nap**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 2**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**To do something forty times**' refers to repeating the same action repeatedly.
 
• '**To hurry and rush**' means to move or act with speed.
 
• '**To be worried**' means to be anxious or troubled about actual or potential problems.
